question: Can I carry unused leave into next year?
answer: Yes. You can carry up to 5 unused days into next year [1], and you must use them by 31 March [2]. Days above the limit are lost unless your manager approves an exception before 15 December [1], [3].
coverageNote: None of the sources say whether the 5-day limit is lower for part-time staff. Ask HR before you plan around it.
